Anita P: Heads up - partner X showing daily SKU counts off by ~5-20% after midnight cutover. billing vs partner reports mismatch.
Mike L: Do we have a repro? timezone? enqueued vs event timestamp?
Anita P: looks like partner is reporting usage with local_date bucket, but our agg uses UTC_day. example: partner payload: {"usage_ts":"2026-03-15T23:50:00-07:00","sku":"S2-large","units":5}
Jordan K: ah that would push to next day in UTC. our daily rollup SQL uses date_trunc('day', usage_ts at time zone 'UTC')
Sara V: can we map partner local_date -> UTC window? or accept partner local_date if they declare TZ
Anita P: partner refuses TZ change; suggested we accept their local_date field and map to our hour buckets.
Mike L: proposal: add translation layer in ingest: if payload contains local_date and tz_offset, compute window_start_utc and tag with partner_local_date.
Jordan K: quick proto: UPDATE ingestion SET window_start = date_trunc('hour', (usage_ts AT TIME ZONE coalesce(tz, 'UTC'))); -- pseudo
partner-bot: new webhook replay scheduled: replay_id=rp_20260315_003 queued
Anita P: also found SKU normalization mismatch: partner uses S2-L, we use s2.large. need mapping table.
Sara V: I'll ask partner to provide canonical sku mapping CSV. pinging @eng-partnerships for SLA change.
Mike L: risk: cash reconciliation impacted for yesterday's run. recommend stop-gap: apply heuristic mapper for common variants and run backfill.
Jordan K: running a one-off backfill tonight, ETA 3h. will post logs at end.
Anita P: thanks all — can someone own the mapping PR and the replay? @Mike L?
Mike L: taking replay and PR. will open PR with tests.
Sara V: adding notes to partner runbook and sending partner-facing summary.
Anita P: :thumbsup:
